title: Withholding an Amendment Charge on a Vacation Package
content:
A change to the travelling party that the operations desk has approved is charged as an amendment under this rule whether a member is replaced or a place is simply given up, and the administration charge per traveller is the one this rule fixes and no other. This governs across the Vacation Package Products.

Where places are given up under a change to the travelling party that the operations desk has approved, no cancellation ladder is read and no cancellation penalty or cancellation administration charge is withheld.

## What the charge attaches to

The charge is withheld against the payment line that settled the balance of the package, and against no other.

## What withholding it does

One act adds a single amendment charge line to the named package's ledger for the amount given, in the currency the party is presented with, and ties it to the payment line the charge is withheld against. The charge posts on the current business date, is raised against the party as a whole rather than any one traveller, and raises what the party has been charged on the package by that amount. The party sees the amendment charge on the package statement from that moment. Withholding it is the desk's own act, performed by the agent.

## How it is withheld

The agent-side tool `withhold_amendment_charge_5474525c` is unlocked and then called by the agent.

## What must be given

| Given | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bundle_package_id` | the internal reference number of the vacation package the amendment charge is raised against, read from the package record returned by the package lookup | an identifier |
| `amendment_charge_usd` | the amount withheld from the party for the amendment; it is the total for the whole party rather than a figure per traveller | a USD amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the nearest cent, and never negative |
| `currency_charged` | the currency the party is presented with for this charge; it records presentation only and never converts the amount given | an ISO 4217 currency code, 3 uppercase letters, in upper case and with no spaces |
| `source_entry_id` | the reference number of the payment line already standing on the package that this charge is withheld against, read from the ledger lookup for that package | an identifier |

## What comes back

A one-line confirmation string. It contains the reference number of the ledger line created, a string that begins with the letters bna and an underscore, the amount withheld in US dollars to two decimal places, and the package reference number it was raised against. A string of this shape means the amendment charge is now standing on the package; any other outcome means nothing was withheld.
